comparison.objective: Candidate depins a connector terminal; record shims a door jamb with two opposed wedges.
comparison.physical_skill: Fine recessed latch access and coupled extraction versus bimanual opposed wedge insertion with force balancing to close a variable gap.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires intact selective removal but lacks measured force/damage thresholds. Record requires opposing shims, at least 70 mm overlap, at most 0.05 mm free space, bounded jamb bow, rest, and hands clear.
comparison.reason: Insertion and force control are generic; the wedge-packing and structural bow-control ability is meaningfully different.
